## 222de43cc4aa

**Reproduced override-contract defect at generator SHA-256 `0e43a13ef9eb3745adf7a22d5973a2e9b7a0d691666136b25adaf7d0d0b7b04a`.** The generator declares axes `grid_h`, `grid_w`, `n_fg_colors`, and `texture`, but accepts undeclared `bogus_axis=1` without error and returns a byte-identical grid to the baseline call. The grid passes `self_check`, and the selected Racket program executes successfully. It also accepts `texture="bogus"` even though that value is absent from the declared texture domain.

The exact accepted unknown-axis input is `checks/audit/222de43cc4aa/input.json`; its selected-Racket receipt is `checks/audit/222de43cc4aa/racket.json` with executed rule hash `ce9518b81cf8`. Full calls, observed properties, equality checks, and the invalid texture case are in `checks/audit/222de43cc4aa/probe.json`. The optional isolated lint stage passed (`checks/audit/222de43cc4aa-lint/`), so the current lint surface misses this silent-control failure. No source was changed; audit-only finding.
